subject: Signature sequencing / launch onramp — final MAP & go/no-go
body:
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@aperturehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@aperturehealth.com
Date: Tue, 7 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final MAP and signature sequencing for go/no-go

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement is asking for a tightly scoped mutual action plan (MAP) with explicit approval gates and signature timing so our legal and finance teams can lock the start date. Can you share a final sequencing plan that aligns the SOW, security evidence, and the targeted go/no-go decision?

Key constraints from our side:
- Procurement needs the SOW and redlines returned by EOD Friday (5/11).
- Exec sponsor wants the final internal approval meeting on 5/15 (PDT).
- Start date should be no earlier than 6/1 and no later than 6/8 to align integration windows.

Appreciate a succinct plan that shows who signs when and any fallback windows if the exec call shifts.

Best,
Emily
Emily Carter
VP, Platform Strategy
Aperture Health

---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2028 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Final MAP and signature sequencing for go/no-go

Emily — thanks for the clear constraints. Attached is a concise MAP (MAP_Aperture_v3.xlsx) and a draft SOW (SOW_Aperture_draft.pdf). High level plan below — this is what we'll route to your procurement and exec teams: 

1) 5/07–5/09: Final technical clarifications & security evidence exchange
   - Action: Redwood provides security-evidence-summary.docx and the list of SOC2 artifacts.
   - Owner: Rishi (Redwood) / Emily (Aperture)

2) 5/10–5/11: Procurement & legal redline window (target return by EOD 5/11)
   - Action: Aperture legal to provide redlines; Redwood legal to respond within 24 hours of receipt.
   - Owner: Aperture Procurement / Camila (Redwood Legal Liaison)

3) 5/12: Final internal alignment (Redwood & Aperture) — freeze SOW for exec review
   - Action: Deliver final consolidated SOW and summary of redlines.
   - Owner: Lauren (Redwood GTM) / Emily

4) 5/15: Exec approval meeting — formal go/no-go checkpoint
   - Action: Execs confirm approval or surface final blockers. If approved, parties proceed to e-sign.
   - Owner: Aperture Exec Sponsor / Redwood Exec (Lauren)

5) 5/16–5/18: Signature sequencing and e-sign window
   - Primary path: Aperture signs on 5/16; Redwood countersigns same day.
   - Fallback: If exec window slips, we open a staggered signing window 5/18–5/20.
   - Owner: Procurement (Aperture) / Jordan (Redwood Ops)

6) Target start date: 6/1 (preferred) or 6/8 (latest) — engineering onramp schedule attached in MAP.

Notes and risks:
- If legal redlines change commercial terms materially, the exec meeting may need to shift; propose a two-hour buffer on 5/15.
- E-sign: we'll use DocuSign; Jordan will pre-seed the envelope and route the signing order to minimize turnaround.

I'll loop Camila + Jordan below for procurement and e-sign specifics. Let me know if Aperture wants an earlier exec slot.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Emily Carter <emily.carter@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 May 2028 08:39:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Final MAP and signature sequencing for go/no-go

Emily / team — quick procurement note from my side: 
- We can accept the SOW redlines on 5/11 EOD but need commercial changes called out in a single document (not inline). Please put any pricing/term changes in a redlines_summary.pdf so legal can triage quickly.
- Approvals that require CSAT or data residency addenda will add one extra day to legal review. If Aperture has any of these requests, flag them today.

Action items assigned here: 
- Aperture: send redlines_summary.pdf by 5/11 EOD (procurement@aperturehealth.com)
- Redwood: Camila will review redlines and post a summary by 5/12 10:00 PDT

If procurement needs an alternate signatory order (finance first vs. exec first) note it now — Jordan will configure the DocuSign routing accordingly.

Camila Reyes
Manager, Legal Ops | Redwood Inference

---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Emily Carter <emily.carter@aperturehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 9 May 2028 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Final MAP and signature sequencing for go/no-go

Team — I prepped the e-sign flow and the envelope. Summary: 
- Envelope name: Aperture Health SOW — DEAL-8472
- Signing order: Aperture Exec Sponsor -> Aperture Procurement -> Redwood Countersign (Lauren) -> Redwood Legal (Camila, as FYI)
- Primary e-sign window: 5/16 09:00 PDT to 5/18 17:00 PDT
- Alternate window (if exec meeting delayed): 5/18 09:00 PDT to 5/20 17:00 PDT

I attached the pre-seeded DocuSign link in the MAP sheet (Drive link). If Aperture wants finance to sign before execs, I can flip the order but that will place the final countersign in the same day only if all parties sign within 24 hours.

One operational ask — Aperture please confirm the exact signing names/titles for the envelope to avoid name mismatch holds (these generate automated identity checks and slow the flow).

Jordan Blake
Manager, Customer Onramp | Redwood Inference

---
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@aperturehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Final MAP and signature sequencing for go/no-go

Thanks everyone — that plan works. Procurement will send the redlines_summary.pdf by EOD 5/11. Exec sponsor confirmed the 5/15 meeting. Signing names below: 
- David Hsu, SVP Product (Exec Sponsor)
- Maria Velazquez, Director of Procurement

We are aligned on 6/1 as target start date; Aperture will escalate internally if anything moves. We will use the primary e-sign window. Please confirm once the DocuSign envelope is live and we have the HubSpot deal updated.

Emily
Emily Carter
VP, Platform Strategy
Aperture Health

Attachments referenced: MAP_Aperture_v3.xlsx; SOW_Aperture_draft.pdf; security-evidence-summary.docx
